# Relative Green sewing is generated by slot collisions and tail flux

## Strength and result

**Finite-cutoff relative comparison theorem.** There is a source constructor for the ordinary cut-dependent correction. It uses the typed memory-slot merging map to enumerate newly matching record shapes, and assigns their pairings using the independently derived tail Green current.

The correction is not obtained by fitting a metric or merely declaring it to be the difference of two forms. Its construction precedes that comparison. The resulting theorem identifies it with the discrepancy and proves the nested-cut transport law.

The construction lives on the rich common carrier with its original cut labels. It does not make the compressed carriers isometric, recover discarded cuts from a coarse record, or establish an infinite-packet completion.

## 1. Fixed data and variance

Use the six-prime common ordinary carrier from the preceding note:

M=direct_sum C_1 tensor R_middle tensor C_3,

with the first and last seam complexes, the full middle memory, and both intermediate vertices retained. The source image in bottom degree is

j_0(a tensor [w] tensor c)=D(a) tensor rho(w) tensor D(c).

After shifting by [-2], this is in degree zero and retains all 2160 ordinary common coefficient coordinates. The 720 product coordinates remain separately in degree -1 through the existing three-seam map.

Fix one feature envelope, its existing signature, the memory weight tau, and a common capacity N>=6. Consider typed coarsenings chi that concatenate adjacent MEMORY slots and forget the corresponding internal cut labels while retaining the seam letters and outer endpoints. They act forward on record vectors by kappa_chi. Forms and observations pull back contravariantly.

All admitted source templates are below the common capacity. The constructor below is not asserted for operations that discard top-degree records by truncation, change weights, cross seam letters, or change the source feature map.

The actual root carrier is a single external factor. Its state-dependent paired packet multiplies all the formulas; no root state is fitted or duplicated.

## 2. Source incidence selects the correction terms

A fine record shape specifies its typed seam edges, all intermediate vertices, vacuum or feature seam letters, and the degree of each separate memory slot. The ordered feature words are separate data.

For two fine shapes alpha,beta, the source coarsening chi determines whether their images become the same coarse shape. A NEW MATCH is a pair with different fine shapes but equal coarse shapes.

Enumerate these pairs using the typed word map alone. For each new match, keep the ordered feature pairings, each spectral pair, the prescribed weights, and the root pairing. Their sum is the correction T_chi.

This is an operational definition independent of either completed coarse Gram matrix. It requires no inverse of a relation Gram matrix and no scalar target identity.

When a record contains no retained feature, the new match contributes its vacuum/vertex-incidence pairing, with empty product equal to one. This is a separate incidence channel, not a nonzero-forcing Green integral. For example, distinct first cut vertices 3 and 5 can be forgotten while the seam edges 0->1 and 15->31 remain the same. Their all-vacuum coordinates then acquire a coarse cross-pairing absent on the fine direct sum.

## 3. The independent source current for a feature pair

Let f,g be the actual compact shell forcings. Use the raw four tails G_(sigma,j), with sigma=(+,-,+,-), j=(0,0,1,1), and the fixed raw coefficient C=A_Cl^* J A_Cl. The signature J is on the normalized two-sheet carrier; C is rank two and is not a four-dimensional signature.

The source tail equation is

G_(sigma,j)'(g;z;x)=-sigma i z G_(sigma,j)(g;z;x)-x^j g(x).

For one pair of ports define

E_ab(x)=conjugate(G_a(f;w;x)) G_b(g;z;x).

Differentiating by the actual tail equation gives

-E_ab'(x)
 = i(sigma_b z-sigma_a conjugate(w)) E_ab(x)
   + conjugate(x^(j_a) f(x)) G_b(g;z;x)
   + conjugate(G_a(f;w;x)) x^(j_b) g(x).

Thus the sewn flux E_C=sum_ab C_ab E_ab has an independently constructed bulk density B_C and forcing density R_C satisfying

-E_C'=B_C+R_C.

For the prescribed four-port matrix, the forcing density reduces exactly to

R_C=conjugate(f)(G_(-,1)(g)-G_(+,1)(g))
    +(conjugate(G_(-,1)(f))-conjugate(G_(+,1)(f))) g.

This cancellation follows from the fixed coefficient rows and columns. It does not remove the first-moment tails or reconstruct them from the target kernel.

## 4. The divided boundary current

Keep d(w,z)=-i(z-conjugate(w)) attached to its own spectral pair. On the upper-half-plane region it is nonzero. Put

F_(f,g)(x;w,z)=E_C(x)/d(w,z).

Compact shell support makes the tails zero beyond a finite endpoint. Integrating the source equation gives

K_(f,g)(w,z)=F_(f,g)(0;w,z)

 = integral_0^infinity [B_C(x;w,z)+R_C(x;w,z)]/d(w,z) dx.

The numerator at zero is exactly the normalized function-valued Clark feature numerator. This is the source current assigned to each non-vacuum pairing selected by the incidence constructor.

Bulk and forcing contributions remain separately labelled. For a finite spectral superposition, apply this formula entrywise before summing its two coefficient indices. Do not aggregate numerators and divide by one denominator.

For signature-transformed observer channels, replace C by the already prescribed constant matrix

M_(epsilon,delta)=A_Cl^* J^(epsilon+delta+1) A_Cl.

The same tail differentiation gives their currents. In particular, the positive sewn coefficient A_Cl^* A_Cl has forcing density

conjugate(f)(G_(+,0)(g)+G_(-,0)(g))
 +(conjugate(G_(+,0)(f))+conjugate(G_(-,0)(f))) g.

These are existing observer channels, not new arithmetic generators or fitted metrics.

## 5. Several retained slots require a labelled product boundary

A newly matching shape may have d retained feature slots. Its correction is the product of their d source kernels, with all spectral pairs and memory weights retained.

Equivalently, use d independent spatial variables and integrate the product of their labelled bulk-plus-forcing densities. This is a product-domain boundary current, not an integral in one arbitrarily identified spatial variable. Expanding the product preserves the individual choices of bulk and forcing channel in every slot.

At finite cutoff these integrals are justified by compact shell support and the existing upper-half-plane feature bounds. No uniform completed-prime estimate is inferred.

## 6. Comparison theorem, after the constructor

Let q_fine be the prescribed tensor form on the uncompressed carrier and q_chi that on the coarse carrier. Then

kappa_chi^* q_chi = q_fine + T_chi.

Proof: expand the two vectors in their actual typed record shapes. If two fine shapes already match, concatenation preserves their ordered feature pairing and weight: the memory weights multiply as tau^(2r) tau^(2s)=tau^(2(r+s)). Seam-letter weights are unchanged because no feature is moved into or out of a seam-letter slot. If the images do not match, the coarse pairing is zero. The remaining terms are exactly the new matches enumerated in section 2, whose kernels are the source currents of sections 3–5.

The formula is therefore a consequence of the source incidence constructor and Green identity. It is not their definition.

For the previously found ordinary two-vector hostile, the constructor selects the two first-edge Omega terms and the last forgotten cycle. It gives

T_L(A,B)=4 w_memory [B_(g,h)+R_(g,h)]/d(w,z),

T_R(A,B)=0.

This recovers the full nonzero spectral discrepancy, with g the retained middle event and h the sum of the two relevant first-block suffix event windows. The right carrier has no matching first-block grade for that pair.

## 7. Nested-cut law without extra coherence parameters

For successive permitted coarsenings chi then psi, the forward record maps compose by associative concatenation:

kappa_(psi chi)=kappa_psi kappa_chi.

A pair of fine shapes that becomes equal after both steps either becomes equal at the first step or only at the second. These cases are disjoint. Ordered features and spectral labels are unchanged. Hence the constructor itself satisfies

T_(psi chi)=T_chi + kappa_chi^* T_psi.

In particular, for three adjacent memory groups, merging left-first or right-first yields the same total current after the remaining merge. There is no independent pair or triangle correction parameter.

This is a finite coarsening law for the declared memory-slot operations on the ordinary seam shapes. It is not an unrestricted comparison theorem for arbitrary derived block quotient functors or arbitrary changes of relation factorization.

## 8. Spatial sewing uses the transported tail base

The current also composes under a spatial cut c:

F(a)-F(b)=[F(a)-F(c)]+[F(c)-F(b)].

Both occurrences of F(c) use the SAME tail state of the original forcing. The source transport is the affine tail equation; for a port,

G(b)=exp(-sigma i z(b-a)) G(a)
     - integral_a^b exp(-sigma i z(b-t)) t^j f(t) dt.

Resetting the tail to zero at the internal cut would change the base and destroy the cancellation. Similarly, splitting the forcing into shells retains all cross-shell pair currents; it is not a diagonal-only decomposition.

Thus the spatial interface term is fixed by source transport. It is not a new free boundary condition chosen to cancel the anomaly.

## 9. What is corrected, and what is not

On the rich common carrier, retain the RELATIVE packet

(coarse paired observation pulled back along kappa_chi, T_chi),

with its original cut labels, grades, source states, and spectral indices. Its normalized difference is the prescribed fine pairing. The current is retained as a typed boundary/forcing datum; it is not silently discarded.

This neither modifies the fixed Clark signature nor produces an isometry of the original coarse carriers. The correction generally needs the fine cut labels, so it is not asserted to descend to a form of an already compressed record alone.

Keep this ordinary packet beside the existing three-seam shifted observation. The correction does not change its chain map, connecting projection, or 720 product directions. The uncompressed ordinary image also remains injective on all 2160 coefficient directions. No direction is quotiented on the basis of a scalar cancellation, and no claim of nondegenerate relation self-pairing is made.

The missing unrestricted gates remain: descent through nonminimal factorization relations, extension beyond the declared memory-slot coarsenings, and a completed analytical topology with convergence and noncollapse controls. The finite relative law does not settle them.
